pages.text: The $(item)Tensor Pretraining Cluster$() needs LuV power, coolant, $(bold)32 CWU/t$() and $(bold)96 TB$() of online memory. Its whole base can share a compliant raised floor with the room racks. For a different room, connect its native computation receiver by optical pipe to a source switch or compute rack transmitter. A remote switch also publishes its room memory.

pages.title: The 7×6×7 Stepped Structure
pages.text: $(li)$(#0E7490)y=0..1$(): the heavy $(item)Computer Casing$() base; the controller is on the $(bold)second layer's front face at (2, 1, 0)$(), and every hatch rides this layer.$(li)$(#0E7490)y=2..3$(): the $(bold)waisted$() mid-section, inset one ring on all sides, wrapped in a full band of $(item)Cleanroom Glass$() core windows with the $(item)Advanced Computer Casing$() compute spine standing visibly inside.$(li)$(#0E7490)y=4$(): the re-widened shoulder.$(li)$(#0E7490)y=5$(): a $(item)Tungstensteel Frame$() heat-dissipation ring beam on the roof rim only.

pages.title: Checkpoints, OOM and UPS
pages.text: $(bold)Checkpoints$(): progress is written to the save every $(bold)25%$(), so one 2400-tick run has four landing points at 25/50/75/100%. Chunk unloads and save reloads $(bold)resume from the most recent checkpoint$() instead of restarting.$(br2)$(bold)OOM$(): a job declares its VRAM need, and the gate is $(bold)96 TB since 0.6.1$(), supplied by the memory racks' HBM modules — two fully loaded LuV racks (64 TB each) clear it. If the pool is short the cluster $(bold)refuses to start$() and says OOM.$(br2)$(bold)UPS$(): a brownout is covered for 60 seconds; with no UPS cover the run falls back to its last checkpoint and the unsaved stretch is cleared.

pages.title: Standard Training I/O
pages.text: Fit standard $(item)Item Import and Export Buses$() on the computer casing. Import consumes one high-purity mining or chemical dataset. The export bus receives one $(item)Open-Weight Module$() stamped with domain, fp16 precision, version and run count. A full bus holds the completed checkpoint at 100%. Extract an item to let the cluster finish the export.

pages.title: Training Status
pages.text: The controller shows progress, the latest checkpoint, online TB, UPS cover and stop reasons. Use a soft mallet to toggle work. Pipes, hoppers or AE2 can supply the input bus and collect the finished weights from the output bus.
